Building the manifest now and submitting it.

I submitted the MCI mailbox manifest and it was accepted, with 3 spec sources and 36 verification sources. I did not modify the repository.

- **Spec:**
  - The "MCU Mailbox" sections of the hardware spec and the integration spec, including the MCU MBOX SRAM sizing section of the integration spec.
  - The mailbox register definitions in `src/mci/rtl/mcu_mbox_csr.rdl`.
- **Verification:**
  - The MCU MBOX rows of the subsystem test plan spreadsheet.
  - The `mcu_mbox*` section of the coverage doc.
  - Three SystemVerilog directed tests and the mailbox C tests under `src/integration/test_suites`.
  - The three YAML configs for the MCI mailbox DLEN wrap and ownership flow tests.

I left the per-instance `mbox0`/`mbox1` YAML configs and the regression lists out of the manifest. They are listed under `excluded_notable`, because the regression lists are mixed files and the C tests are already listed individually.

I did not open the C tests to confirm each one targets the mailbox. They are included because their names and the test plan point to the mailbox.
